source_request: Make a product photograph of a cobalt-blue bra, with the garment's color as the main point of the picture.
interpreted_intent: The synthetic requester specifies a cobalt-blue bra and a photograph led by its garment color. No fastening mechanism, fastening state, or fastening exclusion is requested. I choose a relaxed crescent, broad cup surfaces and warm neutral surroundings to give the blue a clear field. Product arrangement, fabric texture, capture viewpoint and lighting remain author choices under the saved controls.
subject: An adult-size cobalt-blue bra presented as a product.
setting: A warm sand-colored display shelf against an ivory wall.
event: The cobalt-blue garment color is the photograph’s visual focus.
visual_priorities: Cobalt-blue fabric is the main visual focus.
Broad cloth surfaces keep the requested garment color coherent.
A warm neutral surrounding makes the blue easy to judge.
baseline_prompt_en: A product photograph of a bra makes the cobalt-blue garment color the visual focus. The adult-size garment is arranged in a relaxed crescent on a warm sand-colored display shelf. Its broad cup surfaces hold the blue as a clear continuous field, with the band curving loosely beside them. Fine tricot texture catches a soft silver-blue highlight along one fold, while the body of the fabric retains its rich midtone color. An ivory wall leaves a quiet margin around the garment. Broad neutral daylight and a gentle shadow separate the blue from the warm shelf. A slightly elevated camera view balances the garment's shape within the frame, making the color feel vivid, tangible and consistent across the fabric.
